scope: AI-chat verification acceptance profiles, independent verifier identity, freshness, policy floors, and quarantine semantics
invariants: canonical risk action and external-effect verification policy is an acceptance floor and cannot be weakened by a caller profile
verification checks have deterministic canonical digests
verification receipts must bind exact claim digest claim identity and tenant before acceptance
future verification receipts fail closed and can quarantine
receipt freshness is bounded by explicit acceptance profiles
a passed receipt containing authoritative contradiction is quarantined
independent verification requires identity-bound proof rather than an independent boolean alone
independence proof binds the exact verification receipt and canonical independent check digest
independent verifier actor authority domain and process must be distinct when policy requires
critical verification can require a provider distinct from the generation provider
independent checks cannot postdate the aggregate verification receipt
irreversible or externally observable actions escalate verification to postcondition level
semantic verification uses structured provider-neutral requests with bounded rounds repairs and output tokens
semantic verifier outage blocks high-impact claims and abstains lower-impact claims
semantic repairs preserve lineage and cannot publish before citation rebinding
acceptance and quarantine decisions are deterministic and non-executing

promotion.rule: implemented candidate only; exact-head structural validation, acceptance adversarial regressions, existing deterministic and semantic verification regressions, independent rehash, and AI-file-tree governance must pass before qualification
